dashboard_market_100pct_explained: The dashboard's 'market = 100%' driver split is not a news proportion. It comes from backend/app/ml/inference/e31_engine.py::five_trigger_drivers, which groups SHAP values of the E20 model: market = SHAP(D_last, Dnow, rice_rel) and the other four groups have no model features, so they are 0 and market is always 100% of the attribution. The news trigger composition here is a separate, descriptive measure.
note: trigger_classifier.py and the NLP model are unchanged; market-v2 is a candidate rule for review only
